page_copy.pattern: Publishing 200+ AI-generated blogs weekly requires automation, but automation often results in sterile, template-feeling sites. The opportunity was creating a unique visual identity through custom hand-drawn animations that would make the high-volume automated content feel crafted and personal. Webflow's ability to integrate Lottie animations meant custom artwork could add movement and personality without the file size penalties of video or GIF animations. The challenge was creating enough varied artwork to keep the massive blog platform visually interesting while maintaining cohesive design language.
page_copy.action: Designed and illustrated extensive custom artwork using iPad Pro and Apple Pencil, creating hand-drawn backgrounds and illustrations that were converted to Lottie animations via After Effects and Adobe Illustrator. The animations serve dual purposes: adding visual interest and guiding user navigation through custom line animations that direct attention to different blog sections. Built the Webflow CMS architecture to support 200+ weekly AI-generated blog posts that publish automatically via Make.com automation—users input weekly astrological data, AI generates content, and the system publishes complete with appropriate animated elements. When migrating from Webflow to GitHub Pages, developed Python utility scripts to handle conditional content visibility, external link conversion, image path corrections, and collection page generation across zodiac signs, art deco elements, artist interpretations, and timeline visualizations.
page_copy.measured: Successfully married high-volume AI content generation with custom artistic identity through strategic use of hand-drawn Lottie animations. The automated publishing system handles 200+ weekly posts while maintaining visual cohesion through the custom animation library. The hand-drawn elements transform what could feel like a content mill into a distinctive branded experience. The GitHub Pages migration scripts demonstrate ability to solve complex technical challenges around content visibility, path management, and collection generation—full-stack problem-solving that goes beyond just Webflow design work.
